name: Ripe Orchard
summary: A fruit shop landing page where one mango travels with your scroll, splits open and lands in a crate
about: A sunny one-page shop for a mango seller. A single drawn mango follows your scroll: it bobs in the hero, swings and turns beside the facts, splits into cheeks and seed, drops into a juice glass that fills, then lands in a crate above the shop. The shop has varieties, box sizes, a ripeness picker and a working cart with delivery dates.
how: The headline letters bounce in, the sunburst spins up and the mango pops into the hero with a little bob
Scroll down: the mango swings right and turns over while the facts count up
At Fresh cut it is sliced into two cheeks and the seed; at Juice it drops into the glass, which fills with a splash
Pick Juice, Lassi or Shake to change the recipe and the colour of the drink
In the shop, choose when you will eat them, a box size and how many boxes, then add to the crate
Open the cart to change quantities, pick a delivery city and see the arrival date, then place the order
